title: How to organise the printer and scanning station | Home Office
description:
Turn paper into files and files into paper, without hunting for either.

This is the Printer and Scanning Station in the Home Office. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Paper in a bin directly beneath the printer with a min line and a max line drawn inside it, one spare cartridge in a labelled box beside it, a single scan tray with a to-do side and a done side, clear air behind the machine, and nothing sitting on the lid.

THE SIX PASSES

Straighten: Paper goes directly under the printer, the spare cartridge in a labelled box beside it, and the scan pile gets
Shine: Powered off, lift the lid and clean the scanner glass with cleaner on the cloth, never sprayed onto the glass

Standardize: Draw a min line and a max line inside the paper bin.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Only cartridges matching the printer on the desk are stocked, the paper bin carries a min line, and the top of the machine stays bare.
